question.text: `Roshni Trust`, a Section 12AB-registered NPO running special education for the visually impaired and listed on NSE-SSE, must undertake an annual independent Social Impact Assessment. Under which SEBI (ICDR) regulation is this mandated?

answer.text: Reg 292I — Impact Assessment / Social Impact Assessment

explanation.text: The Logic: Within the SEBI (ICDR) framework for Social Stock Exchange, Reg 292I is the provision that mandates each Social Enterprise listed on the SSE to undertake an annual independent Social Impact Assessment. The output of that assessment feeds the Annual Impact Report disclosed under the broader LODR/SSE framework (notably LODR Reg 91E for the AIR itself). The Trap: Reg 292F governs rights of ZCZP holders (no-voting, return of corpus). Reg 292G is corporate governance. Reg 292J covers SRO oversight of SIAs, not the SE's own assessment mandate. Note: The cited SIA workbook supports that social impact assessment is mandatory for entities on the SSE, and discusses AIR assessment/disclosure under LODR Reg 91E (pp. 210-213), and uses Reg 292I in the ZCZP-issuance context (p. 69). The exact wording 'Reg 292I mandates annual independent SIA' was not located on the pages checked. The framing above reflects the SSE regulatory architecture rather than a workbook-page citation.
